explanation: Aap ki alaamaat kisi sangeen halat ki nishandahi kar sakti hain jise fori tibbi tawajjuh ki zaroorat hai. Barah-e-karam fori tor par emergency medical aid hasil karein.
disclaimer: Sehat Awaaz tibbi tashkhees nahi hai. Tibbi mashwaray ke liye hamesha healthcare professional se mashwara karein. Emergency mein 1122 par call karein.

emergency.label: Rescue 1122
emergency.message: Abhi Rescue 1122 par call karein. Pur-sukoon rahein aur intezar ke doran neeche di gayi hidayaat par amal karein.
